caption: Almost all formula-engine time -- the signature of row-by-row evaluation.

code:
Total Units Sold =
SUMX(
  FILTER(
    ALL(dw.fact_sales),
    dw.fact_sales[store_key] = SELECTEDVALUE(dw.dim_store[store_key])
  ),
  dw.fact_sales[quantity_sold]
)
caption: Manually re-filtering row by row, ignoring the model's own relationships.

eyebrow: AFTER -- letting relationships do the work
code:
Total Units Sold =
CALCULATE ( SUM ( dw.fact_sales[quantity_sold] ) )
caption: ~7,840ms -> ~240ms. A roughly 30x improvement, zero visual changes.

eyebrow: A fix isn't done until the model is audited
